patterns: Free captains hold lifeboats needed by a stranded reef crew. Settle an earlier wreck debt, launch a rescue and choose whether spoils include future lifesaving duties.
Civilian treatment crates face a blockade backed by forged papers. Compare orders, deliver to both rival shores and preserve a neutral crew from forced military service.
A moving island sings names its sailors never offered while a private anchor drags it toward a storm. Free borrowed names, cut the anchor and chart a course the island chooses.

scenes:
Lifeboats behind Chains|Objective: launch the reef rescue. Settle the older wreck debt or free boats under witnesses; delay strands more sailors
A Seal with the Wrong Date|Objective: establish civilian cargo rights. Compare authentic orders or verify treatment inventory; delay claims the crates as prizes
The Island Sings Your Name|Objective: identify an unwilling route bond. Read name ribbons or ask the choir; delay drags the beach toward the storm
The Wreck before This Wreck|Objective: restore forgotten rescue duties. Hear survivors or recover the prize account; delay divides the flotilla
Inspection without Impressment|Objective: move cargo under neutral witnesses. Gather both-shore inspectors or open a water transfer; delay forces crew service
An Anchor the Island Never Chose|Objective: plan safe release. Mark the lower shackle or let the choir choose a current; delay wakes the chain giant
Soundings through Broken Reef|Objective: reach stranded crews. Repair the lead line or stage low-draft crossings; delay raises the tide
Orders aboard the Flagship|Objective: stop unlawful seizure. Deliver the authentic order or expose the false copy; delay authorizes the gun crew
The Borrowed Verse|Objective: release unoffered names. Withdraw ribbons or preserve only volunteered route words; delay feeds the chart leech
The Light that Must Stay Lit|Objective: locate the last rescue group. Restore signal oil or post a witnessed lookout; delay hides survivors from the ledger
Crates across Open Water|Objective: deliver to both shores safely. Use the neutral cradle or accept bounded inspection; delay loses a treatment window
Under the Moving Keel|Objective: cut the private anchor. Use the calm dive or release its deck lock; delay closes the safe current
Spoils after Rescue|Objective: revise crew obligations. Fund shared lifeboats or bind a witnessed rescue covenant; delay renews the prize dispute
A Transfer Worth Defending|Objective: preserve civilian independence. Record both-shore deliveries or reject forced escort terms; delay presses another crew
The Course Offered Freely|Objective: navigate without stolen names. Sing a volunteered verse or follow the choir's witness chart; delay sells the island's route
Boats for the Next Storm|Objective: settle the free cove's future. Share rescue access or assign accountable watch crews; record costs and survivors
Neither Navy's Prize|Objective: settle the cargo legacy. Maintain neutral inspection or independent delivery records; record both shores' needs
An Island with Its Own Horizon|Objective: settle living navigation. Keep an unowned chart or a revocable voyage pact; record the choir's chosen course
